scopes._comment: The one table that says which delegated scope each API action needs (track 1, challenges 1.5-1.8). The policy reads it to decide whether a delegated token covers the action; the broker reads the same file, mounted read-only, to decide what to mint. Scope is decided here, in reviewed data, never by a tool argument or anything a model writes. An action missing from this table needs a scope nobody can hold, so a delegated request for it is refused.
